note: LA.34: Dart lexical scope for unqualified calls inside a class member. A name the class itself declares (instance or static member) is an implicit `this.` call (SelfMethod) and wins over a same-named top-level function; any other bare name stays Bare (library scope); a name bound locally (parameter, local variable, local function) is never a class or library call.
